description: On the fixed diamond, every node has a concrete finite upstream path to root; therefore every pair of upstream endpoints can join there. Its rank proves WF and explicit zigzags prove connectivity. tip has distinct immediate predecessors left/right, while the general confluence theorem gives a unique source and paths from every node. This permits multiple immediate causes and strictly weakens the sufficient LeftUnique condition; it does not establish metaphysical confluence. Root-premise delta zero; no philosophical premise is established.
